attribution.source: eqlwiki.com spell pages (client-mined EverQuest Legends data); Servant of Air from everquest.allakhazam.com
attribution.note: Hand-transcribed verbatim, one URL per entry — never authored. Fills the gap the classic-era P99 wiki cannot cover (it predates beastlords entirely); merged at load in src/quests/index.js, where the fetched P99 snapshot wins any name both files know. Where live-EQ sources disagree with eqlwiki (Sha's Lethargy slows 40% on Legends vs 30% on live), the eqlwiki value is the one this overlay's server actually runs — the per-entry notes record the divergences.

Blessing of the Lord Commander.note: EQL-original cleric spell — no live-EQ entry exists. Cross-checked against eqlbuildforge.com.

Fury of the Chosen.note: Self-only short buff, combat proc on Cudgel of the Fool. EQL slots differ substantially from live EQ (Allakhazam spell 2278).

lines: 1: Increase Current Hit Points by 274 (L27) to 298 (L35)
Herikol's Soothing.note: Beastlord pet heal. Live EQ (Allakhazam spell 2615) prints slot 1 as 'Increase Hitpoints by 193. Max: 298'. Lowercase 'curse' is as printed.

Servant of Air.note: Worn focus effect, not a castable spell — eqlwiki has no spell page for it, so live-EQ Allakhazam is primary. EQL devs state pet foci swap in predefined stronger pets rather than buffing stats.

Sha's Lethargy.note: Beastlord slow, magic resist. Live EQ (Allakhazam spell 2634, Lazarus allaclone) slows 30%; the EQL server value is 40%.

Vigor of Zehkes.note: Beastlord pet heal. Live EQ (Allakhazam spell 2620) prints slot 1 as 'Increase Hitpoints by 431. Max: 671'. Cross-checked against eqlbuildforge.com.

Whirl Bolt.note: NPC-cast on EQL; click effect on Azarack Skin Wristwraps. Identical lines on live EQ (Allakhazam spell 825).
